attchmntText: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: AXISCADES Technologies Limited filed its Q2 and H1 FY27 results presentation for the period ended September 30, 2026. The company completed Phase 1 of its strategic divestment from Akkodis, receiving the first tranche of consideration. H1 retained revenue grew 55% year on year to 378.9 crore rupees, while Q2 retained revenue increased 30% year on year. Q2 revenue was 359.1 crore rupees, with a profit after tax of 47.3 crore rupees. This figure includes 95.4 crore rupees from discontinued operations and a one-time non-cash impairment of 38.4 crore rupees. The company wrote off legacy non-core assets Add Solutions and Epcogen, totaling approximately 58.3 crore rupees. Defence revenue grew 46% in H1, and XIDA revenue grew 55%. Cloud Wave contributed 23.1 crore rupees in Aerospace revenue in H1. The second phase of the Akkodis transaction is expected to close by February 2027.

attchmntText: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: AXISCADES Technologies Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, by its Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. The consolidated net profit for the half year was Rs. 3,254.31 lakhs, compared to Rs. 4,398.79 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was Rs. 4,730.27 lakhs, versus Rs. 2,312.79 lakhs in the prior year quarter. Revenue from operations for the half year stood at Rs. 37,894.68 lakhs. The results include a Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors M/s. S.R. Batliboi & Associates. The Board meeting commenced at 1:30 PM and concluded at 4:00 PM on the same date.

attchmntText: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has scheduled an earnings webinar for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 04:30 PM IST. The session will cover unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1FY27, along with company updates. Senior management will present performance commentary and key financial highlights. A Q&A session with investors and analysts will follow. The event is hosted by Dickenson World. Participants may register using their email ID linked to their Zoom account. Results presentations and press releases will be available on NSE, BSE, and the company website after the board meeting. The financial information discussed includes subsidiaries and joint ventures. Forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties. Queries can be directed to the investor relations advisor.
